deviations.reason: Get Blob returns the blob's own bytes under the blob's own Content-Type (here text/plain, the type the blob was uploaded with). Microsoft's blob.json declares no `produces` on Blob_Download, so its 200 file response ({type: object, format: file}, autorest's stream idiom) inherits the document-wide `produces: [application/xml]`, and the converted openapi.json lists application/xml as the only 200 media type.
deviations.evidence: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/storageservices/get-blob#response-headers (Content-Type: "The content type that's specified for the blob. The default content type is application/octet-stream."; the page's sample response is Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8)
